status: v1.0, ready to build (approved by Vincent Oct 8, 2026); build inside MAPS Phase M, after BATTLE

decisions.1_phase_m: Phase M builds the four Hearthmoor rooms, not the Hearthmoor place panels (#ovPlace only for Fernbrook)
decisions.2_fernbrook: Fernbrook interiors come later, after Route 2; panels until then
decisions.3_respawn: losing a battle wakes you inside the Hearthmoor Lantern House by the beds (respawnIn)
decisions.4_home_nap: the home bed nap heals only; it never sets the respawn
decisions.5_talk_ui: Talk button in the d-pad centre + keeper-sprite portraits (2x, hidden under 360 px)
decisions.6_chatter: ambient chatter in the first build, Hattie and Rook only

_about: Hearthmoor interiors + dialog polish (INTERIORS_DIALOG.md). Source of truth for the interior tiles, rooms, new scenes and the slicePatch that swaps Hearthmoor's place panels for rooms. maps_slice.json is never modified: the game applies slicePatch at load, after maps_slice.json (and after act1_route2.json's patch, which touches only Fernbrook). Fernbrook keeps its place panels until a later pass after Route 2 (decision 2). Checker: interiors_check.py.

viewport.note: Walk map at 390x844 shows about 11x13 tiles (2x scale); at 320 wide it renders at 1x and shows more. Rooms must fit 11x13.

lines.else: @home_bed

lines.!story.starter_received: Your Walkling-box terminal. A row of empty nests glows softly, waiting for someone small.
lines.else: Your Walkling-box terminal hums. Friends you keep but don't walk with rest here. (See the PETS tab.)

lines.story.met_glimmerwell: An ad: "Glimmerwell. Brighter by nature." The jingle is a little too cheerful.
lines.else: A morning show: "Keepers of the Amberwild!" Today: how to tuck in a very sleepy Walkling.

lines.story.seal1: Your map of the Amberwild. You've inked a tiny Seal beside Fernbrook.
lines.else: Keeper primers and a dog-eared map of the Amberwild. Someone drew a star on Fernbrook.
A chipped mug and yesterday's crumbs. The kettle is still warm.
@home_mirror

objs.text: Ilse's note: "Come to the Warden's Lodge when you wake. Someone small is waiting. — I. Marrow"
Ilse's note, folded neat. Someone small found you after all.

The lodge lantern. Every dusk, Ilse lights the Lantern House from this flame.
A warm basket. Something with a hot little nose sniffs at you through the weave.
A cool, damp basket. Something inside goes "blub" very politely.
A leafy basket. A pair of long ears ducks back under the cloth.
An empty basket, still warm from its sleeper.
A scrap of paper in this one: "ROOK'S! HANDS OFF!"
Empty. Ilse has tucked the last little one in by the fire.

lines.!has:name: Ilse's ledger: keepers old and new, in careful ink. The newest line is still blank.
lines.else: Ilse's ledger: keepers old and new, in careful ink. Near the end, freshly written: {player}.

The town lantern. Its glow feels like a hand on your shoulder.

objs.text: A note on the shelf: "Rest as long as you like. — I."

lines.!talked: Oh! Hello, dear. Rook's out, as usual. Mind the kite string on the floor.
lines.!story.starter_received: Rook bolted out at sunrise. That boy runs everywhere. Ilse's handing out partners today!
lines.story.slice_end: Rook says he's a "Junior Bright" now. Sounds very shiny. I just hope they feed him.
lines.else: If you see Rook on the road, tell him supper keeps. And to wipe his boots.
Toast crumbs and a half-drawn kite plan labelled "FASTEST KITE EVER (MINE)".

lines.story.met_glimmerwell: Adventure comics, and a shiny Glimmerwell flyer tucked in front. "Be Bright!"
lines.else: Adventure comics, a cracked kite spool and a jar of very interesting pebbles.

slicePatch._note: Applied at load after maps_slice.json. Hearthmoor's four place-panel doors become room doors (same ids and doorsteps; panel -> to/tx/ty/facing). Hattie and Rook gain ambient chatter (all other fields unchanged). Hearthmoor respawns land inside the Lantern House. Fernbrook is untouched.

lines.!story.starter_received: Off to see Ilse? She's been fussing over three baskets since dawn.
lines.else: Route 1 has shy crabs by the stream. On rainy days they come right out.

chatter.else: Mind the crabs by the stream!

lines.else: Ilse's handing out partners today! Bet I get mine first. Just... warming up.

home_bed: Your bed still smells like hay.
You doze off with {pet} curled at your feet. Everyone wakes up rested.
Too excited to sleep! Someone small is waiting at the Lodge.
home_mirror: The little mirror by the door. You tidy a stray hair.
lantern_rest: Three soft beds under a warm lantern.
You all doze in the lantern glow. Your team is rested.
The beds look cosy, but you have no one to tuck in yet.
ilse_chat: The Fernbrook Seal! Fen wrote to me. She says you were kind to her orchard.
Rook's pacing at the east gate, isn't he? Win or lose, come home smiling.
{pet} looks bright-eyed. Keep that glow going, {player}.
Safe roads, then. The Lantern House by the gate is always lit.
